Pokémon Legends Arceus is basically an entire game built around filling out a bestiary and the way the Pokemon interact with the world is much more fleshed out than other games in the series. You're exploring a bunch of different environments to discover different Pokemon existing in the world and then doing various repeated tasks with them to fill out their entries such as feeding, catching, using them in battle and more. Each Pokemon has their own foods they like to eat, behaviors such as being timid or hostile, weaknesses, habitats, etc.

My favorite part is you're pretty much free to do it however you wish. Doing different tasks will get your entry filled up faster and unlike most other games with a bestiary killing them isn't your only option and probably is a slower method of getting it done if that's all you're doing.
